prompt:
The section file sections/promo-popup-offers.liquid renders a promo popup. Its markup loops over section.blocks, skips any block that is not of type "offer", is marked hidden, or has a blank code, and stops after section.settings.max_offers offers. A separate loop renders "note" blocks. The markup is correct. The {% schema %} block is wrong: setting ids and types do not match what the markup reads, the note block is missing, and the limits are wrong. Do NOT change the markup. Replace only the JSON inside the single {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block so that it is exactly the following. Key order inside objects does not matter. Array order DOES matter. Do not add any keys that are not listed.

Top-level keys:
- "name": "Promo popup"
- "tag": "aside"
- "class": "promo-popup"
- "max_blocks": 6 (integer)
- "settings": array, in this order:
  1. {type "text", id "heading", label "Heading", default "Limited time offer"}
  2. {type "range", id "delay_seconds", label "Delay before showing", min 0, max 30, step 1, unit "s", default 5}. All numbers are JSON integers, not strings.
  3. {type "range", id "max_offers", label "Maximum offers shown", min 1, max 4, step 1, default 3}. There is no unit key.
  4. {type "checkbox", id "show_once", label "Show once per session", default true (boolean)}
- "blocks": array, in this order:
  1. {type "offer", name "Offer", settings: [ {type "text", id "code", label "Discount code"}, {type "textarea", id "description", label "Description"}, {type "checkbox", id "hidden", label "Hide this offer", default false} ]}. The offer block has no "limit" key, and code and description have no default.
  2. {type "note", name "Note", limit 1 (integer), settings: [ {type "richtext", id "text", label "Text"} ]}. The text setting has no default.
- "presets": exactly one preset: {name "Promo popup", blocks: [{type "offer"}, {type "offer"}, {type "note"}]}, in that order.

The file must still contain exactly one schema block, placed after the markup, and it must pass Theme Check. Change only sections/promo-popup-offers.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
